title: agrostis coarctata subsp. trinii
intro: Agrostis coarctata subsp. trinii, commonly known as Blue Fescue Grass, is a type of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis coarctata subsp. trinii include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing and fighting off infections. However, the bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, and more research is needed to confirm its potential health benefits.
